{{Top|leg}}
A '''vibrochisel''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist's]] tool. Used by [[Sculptor/Legends|sculptors]], the tool was employed to carve works of art. The vibrochisel could also be used as a makeshift weapon if the need arose.<ref name="PGT">''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]''</ref>
